Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1293286 (Polyadenylate-binding protein 1). Join activities with assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
